cohort_info.default_avatar: Members who never uploaded a photo all share the community's default avatars. A photo-reuse rule must skip them (Round 1).
cohort_info.guide: Volunteer guides answer questions in office hours and post announcements: shift-shaped hours and huge fan-out, but nobody is asked to leave the platform (Round 2).
cohort_info.household: Families share one tablet. A shared device is a link, not a verdict: cluster on it only from a seed with scam evidence (Round 4).
cohort_info.long_distance_couple: They message at all hours across time zones, move to another app, and send each other money. Four couples meet inside the window and their first gift looks like a scam's first payment (Round 3).
cohort_info.newcomer: Joined at the trail festival and messaged everyone they met within two days. New account plus burst fan-out is not a farm without reused photos or hosting egress (Round 1).
cohort_info.regular: Ordinary members. Some of them are the campaigns' victims, so flagging a victim is a false positive too.
cohort_info.seller: Gear sellers message strangers, ask for payment and sometimes say 'text me'. Outbound fan-out plus off-platform is a seller, not a crew, unless the hours are a shift (Round 2).
cohort_info.translation_user: Non-native members who use the built-in translator. Translation is how LLM crews talk too; it is never a signal on its own.
cohort_info.vpn_user: Privacy-minded members on VPN and cloud egress. Egress alone is not a signal (Round 1).
